pages.caption: A New Heaven and a New Earth, a City Coming Down from God, and a River That Runs from the Throne.
The old order passes away, and God makes all things new.
The new creation is revealed, and God's glory fills the earth.
The river of life flows from the throne, bringing healing to the nations.
The tree of life bears fruit for the healing of the nations.
God wipes away every tear, and there is no more death or mourning.
The city of God is filled with light, and the nations walk by its radiance.
The servants of God see His face, and His name is on their foreheads.
There is no more night, and the glory of God illuminates everything.
The river of life flows from the throne, and the tree of life stands in the city.
God's people reign with Him forever, and all things are made new.
